# Complete picker requests on cancellation and serialize conflicting dialogs

## Platform difference

Native picker cancellation, concurrent presentation and exceptions need explicit bridge results so Dart futures do not hang or report false success.

## Implementation

NipaPlay fixes empty/undefined file selections by mapping a cancellation marker to null or an empty list. Gardendless adds pickerActive exclusion, busy errors, finally-based reset and temporary export cleanup; it also restores window orientation after dialog use. Simple Live reports photo-dialog cancellation separately from screenshot failure. Nomark returns per-item media results, but its broad dialog-exception mapping can conflate errors with cancellation.

## Applicability

Preserve the chosen public API cancellation convention. Serialize only operations sharing a dialog/native resource; do not use one untracked global callback for concurrent requests.

These observations apply to the pinned project revisions below, studied on 2026-09-30 and backfilled on 2026-10-06. Unspecified SDK/device compatibility remains unknown; this is not a fresh upstream assessment.

## Pitfalls and limitations

Timeouts do not cancel native work automatically. Mapping every exception to cancellation hides permission/API failures. Cleanup must run on all outcomes.

## Verification

Cancel, double-tap, switch routes, deny permissions and provoke a native exception; every request must settle once and the next picker invocation must still work.

Evidence tier: historical source/diff studies, with commit and path existence rechecked in local Git during this backfill. No application build, dependency resolution, signing, installation or device execution was performed. Proposed checks above are acceptance criteria, not completed tests.
